items.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
items.summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

items.title: South Korea asks its biggest banks how a major crypto hack would hit them
CZ warns of more AI-driven hacks following Binance’s historic $6.4 billion heist
LO:TECH raises $12 million to expand crypto trading into U.S. and Asia
Binance net outflows reach $5.3 billion after record hack. CEO says recovery underway
What’s at stake for crypto as the US votes in the 2026 midterms?
items.summary: Crypto groups spent about $176 million ahead of the US midterms, with control of Congress and the future of crypto legislation at stake.

items.title: Moscow Exchange to launch Bitcoin, Ether and USDT trading in December
items.summary: Moscow Exchange plans to launch crypto trading on Dec. 1 under Russia’s new law, with annual purchase limits for non-qualified investors.

items.title: NEAR token sinks 7% as proposal to cut annual token issuance passes
items.summary: The proposed issuance cut would prevent 11.8 million NEAR from entering circulation over two years, worth about $45 million at today’s price.

items.title: Ethereum Privacy Network Aztec Rolls Out Major Security and Speed Upgrade
items.summary: The “Tierra” upgrade resolves a critical bug from the prior version, adds formal verification, and an AI-powered testing harness.

items.title: Morning Minute: Tom Lee Calls the Binance Hack Bullish for Ethereum
items.summary: Meanwhile, both the BTC ETFs and ETH ETFs bleed outflows in the Binance hack aftermath, dragging down prices.

items.title: Binance Misses Monthly Luna Classic Burn for First Time Since 2023
items.summary: LUNC holders are waiting for Binance’s November burn, but it hasn’t arrived as the exchange recovers from a record $6.3 billion hack.

items.title: Liquid Network Restores Full Bitcoin Backing Two Months After $320M Exploit
items.summary: Blockstream CEO Adam Back said the sidechain's defenses have been hardened, and warned developers not to trust AI-suggested fixes blindly.

items.title: Ethereum Layer 2 Aztec gets Tierra V6 upgrade to support faster private apps
items.summary: Aztec Foundation has rolled out Tierra V6, saying it fixes earlier security issues and doubles the speed of private transaction proof generation.

items.title: Liquid Network restores full bitcoin backing following $320 million exploit
items.summary: Liquid Network said its bitcoin reserves are back to full backing after September's exploit, with Blockstream providing the funds.

items.title: NEAR governance approves proposal to cut token issuance ceiling to 1.6%
items.summary: NEAR's House of Stake passed HSP-029, which lowers the network's maximum annual issuance rate from 2.5% to 1.6% over 24 months.

items.title: Consensys launches cross-ledger settlement and routing stack for institutional networks
items.summary: Consensys launched a technology stack enabling banks to route and settle transactions across independent ledgers without moving assets.

items.title: Binance Details Months-Long Campaign Behind $6.34 Billion Hack
items.summary: The exchange says 98% of impacted tokens have been replenished; its report explains why pausing withdrawals did not stop every outflow.

items.title: Crypto Recovery Services: What to Check Before Paying
items.summary: Tracing stolen crypto is different from getting it back. US consumers should verify a provider’s identity, written deliverables, fees and access to sensitive data.

items.title: Aztec Launches Tierra Upgrade With Faster Ethereum Messaging
items.summary: The new rollup requires contract recompilation and new addresses, while V5 gets roughly 30 days of funded migration support.

items.title: Kraken Restricts Accounts Amid Suspected $133 Million-Plus EU Theft
items.summary: The exchange says its own systems and customer accounts were not compromised and that it is working with law enforcement on recovery.

items.title: ZeroBeta and Lynq Connect Tokenized Treasury Collateral to Lending and Margin
items.summary: ZeroBeta’s integration with Lynq lets institutions pledge tokenized assets while interest continues to accrue, putting collateral control at the centre of the workflow.

items.title: Tria Lets AI Agents Trade Perpetuals With Restricted Keys
